     "id": "NEW-security-headers-activated-by-upgrade",
     "status": "fixed",
     "fix": "Cause: start-server-core 1.167.19's setResponseHeaders() iterated with Object.entries(), so the Headers object passed by src/start.ts produced no headers. At 4de96fa, production therefore sent no CSP, HSTS, XFO and so on; a response carried only Content-Type. 1.169.39 iterates the Headers, so the authored CSP took effect for the first time. It blocked Start's inline hydration scripts, and every cosmology page rendered blank.\n\nFixes, with the policy moved to src/lib/csp.ts:\n- A per-response 128-bit nonce, passed through the request context to getRouter() as `ssr.nonce` (src/lib/csp-nonce.ts). 'unsafe-inline' is still absent in production.\n- 'unsafe-eval' in production, because @rjsf/validator-ajv8 compiles schemas with `new Function`. Without it, e2e chemistry-h2-flow failed with 'Error compiling schema'.\n- connect-src adds the VITE_API_URL origin (plus its ws/wss twin) and a custom VITE_POSTHOG_HOST, like the existing Supabase origin.\n- upgrade-insecure-requests is sent only over https.\n\nsrc/lib/csp.test.ts adds 8 tests. Router 1.170 changes also forced two code updates:\n- Error components now take ErrorComponentProps, whose `error` is `unknown`.\n- The root head() reads `_notFound`, which replaced `globalNotFound`; without this, tsc fails and the 404 title and noindex would silently stop working.",
     "evidence": "A 4de96fa response has no security headers. The HEAD response carries `script-src 'self' 'nonce-\u2026' 'unsafe-eval' https://plausible.io`, and every Start script has a nonce attribute plus `<meta property=\"csp-nonce\">`.\n\nThe first upgraded build, before the nonce fix, logged 'Executing inline script violates \u2026 script-src' and 'Cannot set properties of undefined', and the body text was empty. With the nonce fix but before 'unsafe-eval', the chemistry submit logged 'Error compiling schema' and the URL did not change. Final HEAD: chemistry-h2-flow passes."
